settings.heading: Privacy
settings.intro: Choose what other people can see about you. Changes save straight away.
settings.under18: You’re under 18, so every setting here started at its most private choice. You can change them any time.
settings.loadFailed: Your privacy settings can’t be read right now. Try again in a moment.
settings.saveFailed: That didn’t save. Check your connection and try again.

profile.everyone: Everyone, including people without an account
profile.hint: Your pen name always shows on stories you publish. Your bio and the month you joined follow this choice.

online.label: Show when I’m online
online.hint: Off unless you turn it on. When it’s on, people you follow see a small dot by your name while you’re using the app.

library.hint: Your library is the stories on your Reading, Saved for later and Finished shelves. When other people can see it, it shows on your profile.

only_me.body: Only you can see your library.

people_i_follow.body: People you follow can see your library on your profile.

everyone.body: Everyone can see your library on your profile.

libraryNote.changeLabel: Change who can see your library
